title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Dietary
description: Derived daily nutrient and food-group intakes from the 3-year resurvey's dietary questionnaire (Dietary data at 3-year resurvey sheet). All 14 fields are machine-derived from participants' reported diet, not directly asked, and are available (marked 'Derived') for every questionnaire version -- no not_on_questionnaire sentinel applies to this category.

F1NKJ.title: Energy
F1NKJ.$comment: Derived nutrient. Source states no valid range; 0-20000 kJ/day is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling (~4780 kcal/day, well above typical intake but not physiologically impossible) -- D056.

$comment: Not-enforceable: F1NPROT + F1NTFAT*9/4 + F1NCARB roughly relates to F1NKJ (macronutrient energy contributions), but the exact conversion factors and rounding are not documented in the source and JSON Schema cannot express an approximate arithmetic identity -- left as a cross-field note, no rule added, D056.
